mapper.sql: select id, message_id, source_type, source_id, rag_chunk_id, rag_document_id, page_number, snippet, similarity_score, citation_order from kb_answer_citation
mapper.insert: insert into kb_answer_citation ( message_id, source_type, source_id, rag_chunk_id, rag_document_id, page_number, snippet, similarity_score, citation_order ) values ( #{messageId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{ragChunkId}, #{ragDocumentId}, #{pageNumber}, #{snippet}, #{similarityScore}, #{citationOrder} )
